title: Update plan.md stale sections to match shipped implementation
description: docs/plan/plan.md has drifted from the implementation. Refresh in ONE pass: (1) 'CI Pipeline' section shows a GitHub Actions YAML — GH Actions is intentionally disabled; CI is Argo Workflows template domain-check-build (see CLAUDE.md CI/CD section). (2) API response schemas: actual multi-TLD and bulk responses wrap results with total/succeeded/failed/duration and nest per-domain payloads under 'result' (see README.md API Usage, internal/server/handlers_api.go); plan shows an older flat schema. (3) There is also a dedicated GET /api/v1/check/multi route (internal/server/routes.go) in addition to ?tlds= on /api/v1/check — document it. (4) 'Project Structure' section omits internal/config/ and internal/cli/ which exist. (5) Dockerfile snippet in plan differs from the real multi-stage Dockerfile (non-root user, healthcheck). (6) Record the decision actually taken for Input Validation edge case #45 (private-suffix domains are currently accepted by internal/domain/parse.go and only rejected downstream as unsupported_tld) or mark it as pending if bead bf-<private-suffix> lands first. Acceptance: plan.md sections above match the code; no GitHub Actions YAML remains in plan.md; a reader can map every plan structure entry to a real directory.

title: Fix go.mod module path: github.com/coding/domain-check -> github.com/jedarden/domain-check
description: go.mod declares 'module github.com/coding/domain-check' but the canonical public repo (README.md Quick Start, plan.md, LICENSE context) is github.com/jedarden/domain-check. Consequences: 'go install github.com/jedarden/domain-check/cmd/domain-check@latest' fails, and all internal imports (e.g. internal/server/routes.go imports github.com/coding/domain-check/internal/config) reference a non-existent org. Fix: rename module in go.mod, update every import across cmd/, internal/, web/ (grep for github.com/coding/domain-check), run go mod tidy. Acceptance: grep -r 'github.com/coding/domain-check' returns nothing; go build ./... and go test ./... pass; goreleaser config (.goreleaser.yml) still builds ./cmd/domain-check.

title: CI gate: run go test -race + golangci-lint + 30s fuzz before Docker build in domain-check-build
description: Plan (docs/plan/plan.md, 'CI Pipeline' + 'CI Guarantees' sections) requires CI to run golangci-lint, go test -race with coverage, and 30s fuzz runs (FuzzValidateDomain in internal/domain, FuzzParseRDAPResponse in internal/checker) on every push, with no network calls to real RDAP servers. Actual CI is the Argo Workflows template 'domain-check-build' (jedarden/declarative-config repo, k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/) which only does a Docker build+push to ronaldraygun/domain-check. GitHub Actions is intentionally disabled (see CLAUDE.md) — do NOT add .github/workflows. Fix: add test/lint/fuzz step(s) to the domain-check-build WorkflowTemplate in declarative-config so a failing test blocks the image build/push. Note the related open beads bf-25q/bf-5oq cover the goreleaser/release wiring — this bead is only the test+lint gate. Acceptance: WorkflowTemplate change merged to declarative-config; a workflow run shows lint+test steps executing before the build step; a deliberately failing test aborts the build.

title: Repo hygiene: untrack committed artifacts and remove dead root fuzz corpus
description: Several generated/dead files are committed. (1) coverage.out is tracked despite being listed in .gitignore — git rm --cached it. (2) Root-level testdata/fuzz/ (FuzzValidateDomain + FuzzParseRDAPResponse corpora) is dead weight: Go only reads seed corpora from the package-local testdata/ dirs, and live copies exist at internal/domain/testdata/fuzz/ and internal/checker/testdata/fuzz/ — diff to confirm no unique seed entries, port any that are missing, then delete the root testdata/ tree. (3) Root scripts test-memory-load.sh, test-memory-load-fixed.sh, test-memory-10min.sh duplicate the scripts/ convention — consolidate into scripts/ (keep the newest, delete superseded variants) and fix any references in docs/benchmarks/. (4) .gitignore contains a stray lone '/' line (under the Node.js section) that is meaningless — remove it. Do NOT touch .beads/. Acceptance: git ls-files shows no coverage.out, no root testdata/, no root test-memory-*.sh; go test ./... still passes (fuzz seeds intact in package-local dirs).

title: Reject PSL private-suffix domains in validation per plan edge case #45
description: Plan (docs/plan/plan.md, Input Validation > Edge Cases, case #45) decides: reject domains under PSL PRIVATE-section suffixes (e.g. example.github.io) with a clear error like 'cannot check availability under private suffix'. Actual internal/domain/parse.go deliberately allows them: publicsuffix.PublicSuffix returns icann=false and the code comments 'We still allow it' (two no-op if !icann blocks around steps 4 and 6). Today such input only fails later at bootstrap lookup as a generic unsupported_tld. Fix: in Parse (internal/domain/parse.go), when the public suffix is non-ICANN AND it comes from the PSL private section, return a ParseError with a distinct phase/message; keep genuinely unknown TLDs flowing to the existing unsupported_tld path. Add table-driven cases to internal/domain/parse_test.go (example.github.io rejected; example.invalidtld still handled as unknown TLD) and confirm API surfaces a 400 with a useful message (internal/server/handlers_api_test.go). Acceptance: go test ./internal/domain/ ./internal/server/ passes with new cases; fuzz corpus unaffected.

title: Align Go toolchain versions: Dockerfile golang:1.22 vs go.mod go 1.26.1 vs README Go 1.23+
description: Three declared Go versions disagree. go.mod declares 'go 1.26.1'. Dockerfile builds with 'FROM golang:1.22-alpine' (works only via GOTOOLCHAIN auto-download of go1.26.1 inside the container on every build — slow and fragile, breaks offline). README.md 'From Source' section says 'Requires Go 1.23+', which cannot build a go 1.26.1 module without toolchain download. Plan (docs/plan/plan.md, CI Pipeline section) still shows a Go 1.22/1.23 matrix. Fix: (1) bump Dockerfile builder stage to a golang image matching go.mod (>= 1.26); (2) update README.md prerequisite to Go 1.26+; (3) confirm .goreleaser.yml has no conflicting version assumptions. Acceptance: docker build succeeds without downloading a second toolchain (verify build log has no 'go: downloading go1.26' line); README and go.mod agree; go build ./... passes.
